data.name: Basilio
data.gender_notes: Basilio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word βασιλεύς (basileus) meaning 'king' or 'royal'. Derived from the Proto-Indo-European root *bha- meaning 'to speak'. In the New Testament, Basilides was a Gnostic philosopher. The name Basilio carries the meaning “Royal, Kingly” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Basilio usually hope their child will grow to embody royal, kingly and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: בסיליו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בסיליו הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מלך נועז' או 'גיבור האמונה'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'בסיליוס', שפירושה 'מלך'. השם בסיליו הוא תרגום לעברית של השם היווני 'Βασιλείος', ששימש ככינוי לכוהנים ולמנהיגים נוצרים בימי קדם.

in_greek.name: Βασίλειο
in_greek.meaning: Βασιλιάς τολμηρός και ήρωας της χριστιανικής πίστης
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βασίλειο προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'basileus', που σημαίνει 'βασιλιάς'. Στην χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Βασίλειο συνδέεται με την έννοια της βασιλείας του Θεού και της πνευματικής βασιλείας του πιστού. Ο Άγιος Βασίλειος υπήρξε εξέχων Πατέρας της Εκκλησίας και Θεολόγος του 4ου αιώνα.

in_latin.name: Basilio
in_latin.meaning: Rex audax et fortis in fide christiana
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Basilio derivatur a voce graeca 'basileus', quae significat 'rex'. In traditione christiana, nomen Basilio coniungitur cum idea regni Dei et spiritualis regni fidelium. Sanctus Basilius fuit eminentissimus Ecclesiae Patrum et Theologus saeculi IV.

in_english.name: Basilio
in_english.meaning: Bold king or royal one, associated with Christian faith
in_english.long_meaning: The name Basilio originates from the Greek word 'basileus', meaning 'king'. It is associated with Saint Basil, a prominent Church Father and theologian of the 4th century. The name symbolizes spiritual royalty and courage in faith. In Christian tradition, Basilio represents a strong and noble character, embodying the virtues of leadership and devotion.
